newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Rosgosstrakh share price seen at 500 rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russian Rosgosstrakh share price seen at 500 rbls.

text.p: The Russian Federal Property Fund set the minimum bid for a 50 percent stake in Russian insurer Rosgosstrakh up for auction at 500 roubles per share, Rosgosstrakh's chairman said on Tuesday.
Shares have a nominal value of two roubles following a recent 500 to one split, Vladislav Reznik told Reuters.
Reznik said he hoped Rosgosstrakh shares would be floated on the secondary market, though he did not give details of a plan.
"We shall do everything we can for this," he said.
The 50 percent stake will be sold at a cash auction, though the date has not been determined.
The government's Audit Chamber is reviewing Rosgosstrakh's privatisation plan and the State Duma lower house of parliament asked the chamber to report its results by March 10.

Under the plan, which Duma representatives have said underrepresents the value of Russia's largest insurance company, employees bought 20 percent of shares and have priority rights to buy a further 30 percent.
